dep.name: @nestjs/core
dep.purpose: HTTP API composition, modules, and DI

dep.name: @nestjs/jwt
dep.purpose: Internal JWT issuance for API sessions

tool.name: workspace
tool.value: npm per package (backend, frontend, bot-max, bot-telegram)

PreferredAgentStack.preferred-runtime-library: @prisma/client plus NestJS modules already in backend/src
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-observability-library: NestJS Logger and existing console markers; GRACE log format [Module][function][BLOCK_NAME]

discouraged-surface.reason: Frontend already has mock and real adapters; do not add a third API client.
Course progress must stay on the server.

PreferredAgentStack.discouraged-surface: localStorage as source of truth for learning state

module-level.focus: Fast deterministic NestJS unit tests next to services and controllers

wave-level.focus: HTTP flows already covered by backend/test e2e specs

phase-level.command: cd backend && npm run build; cd frontend && npm run build
phase-level.focus: Typecheck and production build for API and mini-app

Testing.mocking-policy: Use VITE_API_MODE=mock for UI shape; use Nest testing module and Prisma test DB for API. Prefer existing fakes over new monkey-patches.

Observability.logger: NestJS Logger in API; console in bots and bootstrap
Observability.required-fields: correlationId when a request id exists; actorId as numeric user id; never raw tokens
Observability.redaction: Never log JWT secrets, MAX/Telegram init data, passwords, or webhook secrets.

AutonomyPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory MODULE_CONTRACT, or a new third-party auth surface.
AutonomyPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every completed step must emit assumptions, commands, evidence, and next action.

DeliveryShape.shape: Service-oriented: NestJS API, Vite React mini-app, MAX bot, Telegram bot, PostgreSQL/Supabase. Docker Compose for local and prod-shaped deploys.
